_comment: CUTOVER_PLAN NB-7. Single source of truth for scripts/smokeProdReadOnly.mjs (--list prints it) and the table in CUTOVER_PLAN. `steps` run with --read-only against the production AppSync URL: GraphQL queries (plus router reads whose action is GET/LIST/SEARCH/FIND/READ/COUNT/PREVIEW/CHECK/LOOKUP/STATUS), DOM reads, screenshots; zero mutations, asserted. `excluded` cannot run read-only; each refuses --read-only (Cognito client blocked, or an explicit refuseReadOnlyFlag) instead of ignoring it.

steps.title: Config + token check
steps.does: Validates --prod-url (plain AppSync host, never defaulted), BCAT_PROD_ID_TOKEN (an EXISTING smoke user's ID token, not expired, >5 min left, optional --expect-pool; the browser steps also need BCAT_PROD_ACCESS_TOKEN + BCAT_PROD_REFRESH_TOKEN), prints pool id, group names, minutes left. No network.

steps.title: Guard self-test
steps.does: On a separate guard with fake fetch / stub SDK clients: a mutation, a Cognito admin call and a DynamoDB PutItem each throw; a query passes. Proves the guard is armed before it is trusted. No network.

steps.title: API aggregates
steps.does: Paged queries returning ids and status only: counts of Customer, Location, Division, Carrier, Shipment (+ status histogram), Invoice, CarrierBill, and whether TmsSettings 'default' exists. Aggregates are printed, never rows. Compare with the §5 reconcile numbers by hand.

steps.title: Route walk
steps.does: Navigates every parameter-free page route of devVerifyAA AA_ROUTES and devVerifyS2 ROUTES (deduped; no /new form routes, no placeholder routes): shell renders, not bounced to login, no error text, no console exception or HTTP error, screenshot (light). Navigation + screenshots + DOM assertions only; no clicks.
steps.reuses: scripts/lib/aaRoutes.mjs AA_ROUTES, scripts/devVerifyS2.mjs ROUTES, scripts/lib/uiWalk.mjs createWalk

steps.title: Page timing (read paths)
steps.does: Cold navigation of each devVerifyPerf PAGE_PATHS page: first rows, settled seconds, request count, MB, rows. Report-only against dev budgets (prod differs); FAILS only on timeout or a mutation in the page's own fetch log (G0).

steps.title: Create-form render only
steps.does: Opens /tms/shipments/new and /tms/rates/new, asserts the form and its submit control exist, screenshots. Never types, never clicks Create/Save; the request interceptor would block and count any mutation anyway.

steps.title: Zero-mutation assertion
steps.does: Prints `READ-ONLY ASSERT mutations=0 ...` (guard counters: queries, routerReads, sdkReads, third-party writes blocked) and exits non-zero if any mutation, Cognito/SSM/Lambda call or non-read SDK verb was attempted, even if swallowed.
